note: TTS voices an actor may declare (meta.cast.actors.<id>.voice) and the perceived voice of each, used to refuse a speaker whose voice does not fit the character before anything is rendered. Single-voice TTS: in this version every speaking actor must use the project's own TTS voice (project.json voice.voice); per-character voices are a later stage and need a multi-voice TTS. Add a voice here (with its perceived gender) before an actor can use it.
